content: Satan Jesus ira ariga te beteram
Jesus Bur Laili kumik ago lilimaram, se nu yu Jordan beteram pilawaram se Bur ilak sor garagarayam mu te namaram.
Se umu te day tom 40 ko, Satan ira ariga te bitakaso. Jesus tom 40 mu ningi na bo me no arigam, ale tom umu nukum te mu na ko kueram.
Se Satan nu maonam, “Ni Kaem ko Namar agi mu, manga imi balu se bread ko geragukko,” mam.
Bare Jesus balam, “Kaem ko batoga te iwita aniso,” mam: “ ‘Kari na inang ko sokel te la me bagoso.’”
Se Satan ilak kuwim bo kualala nuam mu te ilak nama tarigiram, ale tom mu te la ali imi ko kingdom lilim la kasuru saparam,
ale maonam, “Mel imi lilim la ani ni kisek se ni ko kotam baga se nip biya toko. Mel imi suen la ani aisiman se aninga, se ani awiriya tuekko mu aninga angamang te la.
Bore te se, ni ani perr aisu ale aip biya patawur mu, ani mel imi mu lilim la kisek se nika arukko,” ma balam.
Bare Jesus nu maonam, “Kaem ko batoga te iwita aniso, ‘Ni Kari Biya nika Kaem, umutang la perr tui se nup biya patawu se lagerko.”
Se Satan nu ilak aking Jerusalem namaram, ale temple ko gul kalel biya mu te beteram ale maonam, “Ni Kaem ko Namar agi mu, ni ting palageko.
Mu awuk, Kaem ko batoga te iwita aniso:

content.text: ‘Nu nika ko, ko engel nunga manuk se
Nuna kiting duap ningi ka ilumon se
manga te siwik motam atum mu me dagulko,’ mam.”

content: Bare Jesus nu maonam, “Kaem ko batoga te iwita aniso, ‘Ni Kari Biya nika Kaem mu ira ariga te me bitarko.’”
Se Satan ko ira ariga suen la beteram mu nunguning mena la, se tom udagi kuring bo i kapa tuok agi mu ko iki se nu beteram ale namaram.
Nazareth alo Jesus nubiring tuman
Jesus Bur Laili ko sokel kumik ago lilimaram se peleram Galilee namaram. Se ko dugu duap pagam Galilee wonong suen la ningi geraga saparam.
Nu synagogue ningi kausa den balu balu geragakaso se suen la nup patawukasan.
Nu ko wonong duap te kariaram Nazareth namaram, ale pempem te bitakaso iwita, Sabbath tom te synagogue ningi namaram ale den kaurokko barasu sanamaram.
Se nuna prophet Isaiah ko den scroll te batoga mu taman ale tuman, se urukam nama den bo iwita baluwoso umu te aragam:

content.text: “Kari Biya ko Bur Laili ani agarak bagoso,
mu awuk, nu ani marak sokel aisam,
te den gilalong yawara kariimet kituwura guat nunga manikko.
Nu aga beteram se tairem mu kariimet
talipara ningi anisan owore nunga manik se aratu namamon,
ale kariimet nomotam sisira mu nunga nungek se aking loagamon,
ale kariimet saki alo nuguting te ikup
memek giwasan wore nunga sangik se gopa namamonko,
ale balik, ‘Aitak tom imi, Kaem te
ninga sangukko tom tai aratam,’ ma balikko tairem.”

content: Jesus den umu kau kutuwuram mu batoga scroll ago mu aking moram, ale kari scroll bitaruwara mu tuam, ale daigam. Se kariimet suen la synagogue ningi mu nomotam am nu kote la bitakasan.
Asele nu den apura duap beteram, ale mam, “Den batoga te ani kaurem se nina ikiman mu aitakta ko nunguning kaparam,” mam.
Se nuna nu ko ko den ningo ningo balukasan, ale den welang welang kuring te aratam wore ko ikia nunga moakaso. Se makasan, “Auo, agi imi Joseph ko namar mena agila!” makasan.

Se Jesus nunga maonam, “Ani nunguningta ninga manorsam, nina den pangan imi aninga maonalko, ‘Doctor, ni keta nimi nunguru ale nungerko! Munan ni Capernaum beterem se ana ikiman, uwutatala ka wonong duap te bitarko!’ malko.
Ale den kunasaram ale mam, “Ani nunguningta ninga manorsam, prophet alo nongota nunga wonong duap te mu mel yam ko nunga betesan.
Ikialko. Girakala, Elijah ko tom te, mu imet gerewa suen biya Israel ningi bagakasan. Tom mu te mu yia tom 3 se ko nukum sige 6, tuwik bugulik bo ali me ta kau to arigam se karak biya ali lilim iram.
Bare Kaem Elijah maonam se imet umu bo kote me namaram, mena. Nu maonam se Sidon koma mu ko wonong gotek Zarephath mu ko imet gerewa bo sangukko kote namaram.
Se aking uwutatala, prophet Elisha ko tom te, kariimet kuera laira posara ago mu suen biya Israel bagakasan. Bare Elisha kari suanta diram Naaman, mu Syria kari umu nungam se nungeram,” mam.
Nu uwuta balam, se kariimet synagogue ningi bagaman mu ikiman ale suen la nongomang ninguru magaram.
Se barasaman iluman ale tagiman ilak wonong buring ko arataman, ale duruk te wonong nungurman mu te ilak tarigiman. Ale te sapamon se dagulok ale kuerukko ilak namaman.
Bare nu aguwaya nunga ningi aolak iluwam ale eng am namaram.
Jesus bur memek bo kaoram
Jesus Galilee ko wonong Capernaum te nama kaparam, ale Sabbath tom te kariimet nunga kasurukaso.
Se nuna noko den ikiman ale ikia ninguru nunga moakaso, mu awuk, noko den mu sokel ago.
Se synagogue umu ningi mu kari bo bur memek ago mu sail ago airam ale balam,
“Ha! Nazareth kari Jesus, ni ana awuk nanga bitarko? Agi ni anananga maguwurko tairem e? Ani nika ikisam, ni Kaem ko Kari Laili!” mam.
Bare Jesus bur memek alis ago maonam, “Ni kutek me ale kari sowore bitar ale aratuko!” mam. Se bur memek mu kari mu sisupuram se nomokete dagulam se beteram aratam, bare memek bo me kumik te beteram.
Se kariimet suen biya biririkaman ale nongota nunumi isarukasan, “Kausa imi ko duap awuk ta? Nu marak sokel ago bur memek alis ago guguna nungarso se aratu nama gilingisan!” makasan.
Se ko nirung mu pagam sor wonong pingi pingi anira mu te geraga saparam.
Jesus kariimet kuera ikes karogo suen biya nunga nungam
Jesus synagogue beteram ale Simon ko kawam te namaram. Simon ko nome mu kuera kumik kowar ago aniwakaso, se Jesus nu sangukko isarman.
Se nu nama kumik kuali tararam ale alis ago kuera kowar mu maonam se beteram aratam. Se nu tairate la nungeram ale barasam, ale nunga inang mel nunguru burangikaso.
Worem geragam bainga ningi mu kariimet kuera ikes duap duap karogo mu nongorak Jesus kote taikasan. Se nu suan suan kuting nungumik te bitakaso se nungiakasan.

Se bur memek karogotala kariimet ningi mu aratukasan ale ai balukasan, “Ni mu Kaem ko Namar!” makasan. Bare nu ining nungarukaso ale uwuta me balmonko nuguring kalokaso, mu awuk, nuna nu Kristus mu nuna ikia.
Jesus synagogue ningi den apu apu geragakaso
Se aniram ukiram, tumongola la Jesus kuwim bo kariimet mena mu te namaram. Se kariimet ko loaga laga tai arigiman, ale sor bo te me namarukko guramukasan.
Bare nu nunga maonam, “Ani wonong sang te Kaem ko kingdom ko den gilalong yawara karogo tala apurekkowo, mu borta ko aninga beteram se tairem,” mam.
Ale nu ura kunasaram ale Judea ningi synagogue koma koma ningi den am apu apu geragawakaso.

footnotes.text: Naaman mu kager kari nunga supuling bo. Elisha nu maonam, “Ni namar ale yu Jordan ningi tom 7 guruko,” mam, se butata beteram se kumik nungeram: 2 Kings 5:1-14.
